reason: rullst::htmx::render_page_with_head loads htmx 1.9.12 with its default includeIndicatorStyles, so htmx inserts an inline <style> without the request's CSP nonce and the strict style-src blocks it (the .htmx-indicator rules never apply). The fix belongs in rullst-core, e.g. the htmx-config meta with includeIndicatorStyles false that examples/blog and Nexus already send; remove this entry with it.
